name: Internal Auditor
responsibilities: Supervise and scope internal audits of a business unit or process, deciding how deep to dig based on where the risk actually is
Examine records and interview staff to check transactions were recorded properly and policies were actually followed, not just documented
Recommend controls to management that fix root causes (system reliability, data integrity) instead of one-off patches
skills: Scoping an audit: deciding what to sample and why, given limited time
Reading a process end to end and spotting where a control could be bypassed
Writing recommendations a business owner will actually implement, not just file away
Using ERP, GRC, or data analysis software to pull and test the population of transactions rather than eyeballing a sample
rawSkillPool: Business intelligence and data analysis software
Data integrity and systems reliability review
Reporting to management on asset utilization

evidence.quote: Supervise auditing of establishments, and determine scope of investigation required. Examine and evaluate financial and information systems, recommending controls to ensure system reliability and data integrity.

Examine records and interview workers to ensure recording of transactions and compliance with laws and regulations. Report to management about asset utilization and audit results, and recommend changes in operations and financial activities.
